name: VisDrone: Visual Object Detection and Tracking from Drone Imagery
description: A benchmark dataset collected by the AISKYEYE team at Tianjin University to advance drone-based computer vision. Captured by various drone-mounted cameras across 14 cities in China under varying weather, illumination, and altitude conditions. Contains 10,209 static images and 288 video clips consisting of 261,908 frames annotated with 2.6 million bounding boxes across pedestrians, cars, bicycles, vans, and buses. Supports object detection, single/multiple-object tracking, and crowd density estimation.
